description: SINOE ® - Annuaire des déchèteries DMA is published by ADEME. The directory lists recycling and collection centres accepting household and similar waste. Its stated coverage is France; national surveys from 2009, with biennial observations. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Licence Ouverte / Open Licence. The current-year view uses the most recently entered information, not a new complete survey. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
